metadata.title: Get User Story Parameters
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Collect user story details (title, description, acceptance criteria) from a userStoryId using the team's configured guideline-based approach. Supports various sources: Jira, Azure DevOps, GitHub, manual entry, or requirements documents.

output.description: User story details stored in memory

specificActions: Follow the substeps below in sequence
Workflow: check guideline → execute guideline or manual entry → validate → request missing → store in memory
This step uses guideline-based pattern: teams configure their preferred method
If no guideline exists, prompt user for manual entry in structured format
Required fields: title, description, acceptanceCriteria, source

update: memory.json (current step section with userStory details)

tools: read_file - Read guideline file if exists
list_dir - Check if guideline file exists
bestPractices: Always check for team guideline first before prompting for manual entry
Validate all required fields before completing
Document the source method used (guideline vs manual)
Be specific when requesting missing information
Accept various formats for acceptance criteria (bullets, numbered, prose)

substeps.name: Init-Step: Confirm Principles
substeps.description: Recall operating principles before starting this step
actions: Recall the 5 Core Principles: LOG FIRST, READ JSON, STOP AT CHECKPOINTS, NO TODOS, VERIFY ACTIONS
Output: '✓ Principles confirmed for this step'

substeps.name: Check for user guideline
substeps.description: Look for team's guideline file that defines how to collect user story parameters
actions: Check if .user-processes/guidelines/planning/how-to-get-user-story-parameters.md exists
Note whether guideline is available for use

substeps.name: Execute guideline or request manual entry
substeps.description: Get user story details using the available method
actions: If guideline exists: read and execute instructions from guideline file
If no guideline: prompt user to provide details in structured format
For manual entry, request: 1) Title, 2) Description (as-a-user statement preferred), 3) Acceptance Criteria (list format), 4) Source reference
Accept user story ID and ask user to provide the details associated with it

substeps.name: Validate required fields
substeps.description: Ensure all required information is present
actions: Check that title is provided and non-empty
Check that description is provided and non-empty
Check that acceptanceCriteria has at least one item
Check that source is documented
Note any missing fields

substeps.name: Request missing information
substeps.description: If validation fails, ask for missing data
actions: Present specific questions for each missing field
Format: 'Please provide [field]: [explanation of what's needed]'
Wait for user response
Update collected information with answers
Re-validate until all required fields present

substeps.name: Store in memory
substeps.description: Save collected user story information to memory.json
actions: Write userStory object to current step's informationProduced section
Include: title, description, acceptanceCriteria (as array), source
Include additionalContext if any was provided
Document source method used (guideline name or 'manual entry')

substeps.name: End-Step: Compliance Check
substeps.description: Verify principles were followed in this step
actions: Verify: Was log.json updated for any user interactions?
Verify: Were mandatory actions confirmed with output?
Output: '✓ Step completed in compliance with operating principles'

flow.description: Check guideline → execute or manual → validate → (conditional: request missing) → store. Substep 4 is conditional - only if validation in substep 3 fails.

fields: Information Produced: userStory object with title, description, acceptanceCriteria, source, additionalContext
Decisions Made: Source method used (guideline vs manual)
Notes: Any clarifications or additional context gathered

manualEntryTemplate.prompt: Please provide the following user story details for {{userStoryId}}:
fields: **Description**: Full description, ideally in 'As a [user], I want [goal], so that [benefit]' format
**Acceptance Criteria**: List of criteria that define when the story is complete
**Source**: Where this information comes from (e.g., 'Jira ticket', 'requirements doc', 'user provided')
